L26n2244.name: Possessive-precursor noun slot
L26n2244.description: Fires on the head noun or title just before a possessive or 'of' (Women in Women's Party, master in master's programs, consumer in consumer's point, King in King's College, Bachelor in Bachelor of Science). Pushes toward possessive 's and his/her/their.

L25n51.name: Subword start, markup symbols
L25n51.description: Fires on the first short piece of a word split into tokens, mainly 'Ne' in Neolithic, Neoplatonic and Neijing, plus 'etch', 'diagn', 'Phon', 'Radi', and 'to' in purpose clauses. Pushes toward bold, bracket, underscore and placeholder symbols (**, [, ___).

L26n943.name: Lone 'w' word fragment
L26n943.description: Fires on a lone 'w' or w-initial piece that opens a word split by the tokenizer (w.r.t., w obbling, W adsworth, dw elt, shore/w all). Pushes toward dot and slash runs like './' and '..'.

L26n123.name: Pre-noun slot, method/tools
L26n123.description: Fires on the token right before an expected key noun inside a name or phrase: 'du' in Abdu'l-Bahá, 'ula' in tabula rasa, 'Upper' in Upper Macedonia, 'to' after 'blood flow', 'ep' in epidermis. Pushes toward 'method', 'tools', 'purpose' and 'implementation'.

L26n2777.name: Mid-word name fragment
L26n2777.description: Fires on a middle piece of a rare or proper name split into tokens (Therm|opylae, Schro|ers, Pantag|ruelion, tobra|mycin, Le|ashes), strongest on the stem piece before the ending. Pushes toward 'effect' and 'impact'.

L25n2629.name: Programming-language slot
L25n2629.description: Fires on 'programming' in 'programming language' and on a coding-language name (C in C#/C++, Ruby, R, SQL) just before the word 'language' is expected. Pushes toward 'language' and 'languages'.

L26n114.name: Sentence and line-end punctuation
L26n114.description: Fires on a period or newline that closes a dictionary sense, sentence or number: the period in '22.8°C' or 'python 3.4', '.org' and '.gov' in URLs, and the newline ending a quoted example. Pushes toward heading words like 'Note', 'Explanation' and 'Input'.

L25n943.name: Pre-adjective intensifier slot
L25n943.description: Fires on degree adverbs and modifiers right before an adjective ('extremely', 'increasingly', 'relatively', 'strangely', 'unlike', 'more', 'little'), and on 'No' in the constant 'no lists, no bullet points' system prompt. Pushes toward plain adjectives such as 'personal', 'manual' and 'static'.

L26n2811.name: Face and eye features
L26n2811.description: Fires on words naming face or eye parts and their look, on the word before the next facial term ('eyel' in eyelids, 'facial', 'pale', 'nose', 'red' in redness, 'dark' brown eyes, 'steely'). Pushes toward 'features' and 'countenance'.

L26n1226.name: Unfinished word-stem piece
L26n1226.description: Fires on the first, unfinished piece of a word split into tokens: 'recycl' in recyclable, 'confl' in confluent, 'radi' in radiographs, 'exc' in excise, 'wh' in whanau, 'Pers' in Persia. Pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ting', 'ried', 'ning', 'ry'.

L25n1373.name: Name-start fragment, pipes
L25n1373.description: Fires on the short first piece of a rare name or split word (Cad|mium, Gi|ampetro, Su|ess, Cr|ataegus, Fre|derick, kr|ill, spl|ints), and on 'H' or 'VH' before a continuation. Pushes toward '||' and '|' pipe symbols.

L26n385.name: Agent-noun stem fragment
L26n385.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word that will take a person or audience ending (negot|iator, bre|eder, suff|ragette, Im|ager, optim|isation), and on hyphen-split pieces (egg-ste|aling, phos-ph|atases). Pushes toward 'reader', 'writer', 'viewer' and 'audience'.

L26n733.name: Preposition before a method
L26n733.description: Fires on the connective right before a method or activity phrase: mainly 'by' (by using, by clicking, by analyzing), 'as' after 'such', 'including', 'for', 'After', and the comma before a list. Pushes toward '-ing' verbs like writing, logging and computing.

L25n2001.name: Word-start fragment, current
L25n2001.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'contr' (contraption, contrarious), 'mel' (melons, melting), 'mac' (macrolides), 'con' (concerned, Conventional), 'mar' (marigold). Pushes toward 'current'.

L25n1900.name: Enactment phrase before effect
L25n1900.description: Fires on the verb or preposition in phrases where a law, treaty or bill takes hold ('went into' effect, 'came into' force, 'took' effect, 'taking' place, 'was amended', 'enacted', 'signed'), just before the word effect, force or place. Pushes toward 'effective' and 'effect'.

L26n1190.name: 'sh' word-start, show
L26n1190.description: Fires on a word-initial 'sh' or 'Sh' token starting shake, shower, shut, shark, Shiloh or Shalimar, strongest in show and shower contexts. Pushes toward 'show', 'showing', 'exhibit' and 'display'.

L26n1726.name: Rotation and torque words
L26n1726.description: Fires on rotation-themed word pieces: 'rot' in rotatory, 'angular', 'torque', 'scopic' in gyroscopic. Also fires on unrelated word-internal pieces such as 'icit' in appendicitis, 'dyst' and 'ent'. Pushes toward 'moment', 'moments' and 'mom'.

L26n761.name: Rare-name middle piece
L26n761.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a rare name or word split into tokens (Sol|omon, Vol|canoes, Disr|aeli, Ash|kelon, til|t, ou|pe), and on short capital pieces like 'CAR', 'OR' and 'Col'. Pushes toward short suffix pieces ('ho', 'y', 's', 't') and produces nonsense words when pushed hard.

L25n787.name: Name-start fragment, exactly
L25n787.description: Fires on the short leading piece of a capitalised name or split word (Fre|Paulo, Coh|esive, Hav|elock, ride-h|ailing, VH|DL), mostly at the capital letter. Pushes toward 'exactly', 'exact' and 'perfectly'.

L26n2461.name: Stem fragment, culture
L26n2461.description: Fires on a stem piece in the middle of a longer word where a suffix follows (priv|atised, solic|iting, persu|asively, prov|okes, servic|emen, comm|unism, ser|fdom). Pushes toward 'culture' and 'cultural'.

L26n1663.name: Capitalised name's first fragment
L26n1663.description: Fires on the short first subword piece of a capitalised name or split word, mainly 'Ar', 'Gar', 'Cor', 'Or' starts (Arnett, Aragon, Arbuscular), while later pieces stay near 0. Writes 'rank' tokens, which the steered output only repeats.

L26n367.name: Mid-term fragment before split
L26n367.description: Fires on a piece inside a multi-token term right before the model must finish it, e.g. 'D' in '(DHT)', 'ov' in 'Antonov', 'vel' in 'Roosevelt', 'fly' in 'flyway' or 'Venus flytrap', and '(' before 'Tx'. The meaning is not shared across these cases; writes 'TB/TD/tor' tokens.

L25n1198.name: Tech platforms, list joiners
L25n1198.description: Goes strongly negative on tech and platform nouns (VR, Android, handheld, AWS, Minecraft, iPad, Wi-Fi, mobile) and on the 'and', 'or' or comma that joins them in lists ('iOS and Android'). Writes 'web' tokens, and the steered output is 'web web' spam.

L26n2156.name: El/Sal/Sel capitalised word starts
L26n2156.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a capitalised word or name, mostly 'El' (El Alamein, Elton), 'Sal' (Salamis), 'Sel' (Selaginellaceae), 'Su' (Sucesores), 'Pou'; also lowercase 'sol', 'vol', 'educ'. Writes 'sector/industry' tokens, which the read does not match.

L26n2970.name: 'f'/'ab' start after 'and'
L26n2970.description: Goes strongly negative on the leading 'f' or 'ab' piece of a word that follows 'and' or a hyphen ('brushing and f|lossing', 'full-f|ledged', 'Fire-f|ighting', 'unab|ridged'). Writes 'failure/fault' tokens, and the steered output is 'failure fails' spam.

L26n1072.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L26n1072.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name with a consonant cluster start, e.g. 'Rad' (Radbod, Radchuk), 'cart' (cartilage), 'cond' (conditions), 'trib' (tribosphenic), 'Ram' (Ramnes), and only weakly on the rest of the word. Writes 'Math' tokens, and the steered output is 'Math Math' spam.

L26n2597.name: 'sav'/'ar' word starts
L26n2597.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces such as 'sav' (savable, Savanna, savoury), 'Ar' (Arbuscular), 'sym' (symphony), 'att' (attired), and the first piece of long names ('Mamba', 'Dimocarpus'). Writes 'navigation/nav' tokens, and the steered output is 'navigation' spam.

L25n2732.name: Latin/scientific name starts
L25n2732.description: Fires on the first piece of a Latin, scientific or chemical name split across tokens, e.g. 'H' in 'Hirundo', 'oph' in 'Psophodes' or 'Hymenophyllaceae', 'catal' in 'catalase', 'f' in 'locked'. Writes 'switch' tokens, and the steered output is 'switch switch' spam.

L26n3018.name: Short word-start fragments fe/exc/ca
L26n3018.description: Fires on a short first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly 'fe' (fevers, febrile), 'exc' (excise, excels), 'ca' (cauliflower, carambola), 'mes' (mesosphere), 'inc' (incised); the following pieces stay near 0. Writes 'contract' tokens, and the steered output is 'Contract contracts' spam.

L26n854.name: Split starts: Hos/Imm/vir
L26n854.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, e.g. 'Hos' (Hosack, Hosfeld), 'Imm' (Immunodeficiency), 'iral' or 'vir' (retroviral, retroviruses), 'Ship' (shipwreck), 'oxide' after 'nitrous'. Writes 'monitoring/detection/scan' tokens, and the steered output is 'monitoring' spam.
L26n854.name_orig: Split word starts: Hos, Imm, vir

L26n2171.name: Word-start pieces spr/agr/acc
L26n2171.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces of split words, e.g. 'spr' (sprouts), 'agr' (bermudagrass), 'acc' (Macclesfield), 'cu' (cuirass), 'gu' (guillotine), 'ab' (abstinence), 'idd' (Biddel). Writes 'dot' tokens, and the steered output is 'dot dot' spam.

L26n1642.name: Place-name starts Gar/Bar/Car
L26n1642.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised place or proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Gar' (gariga, Garvan), 'Bar' (Barrow-upon-Humber, Barataria), 'Car' (carob, Carica), 'Bour' (Bourges), 'Guar' (Guarani). Writes 'flight/fly' tokens, and the steered output is 'Flight flight' spam.

L26n1225.name: Str/Dev word starts
L26n1225.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly 'Str' (Strikes, Stroudwater, Strait, stratified), 'Dev' (Devonta), 'sav' (savanna, savoury), 'Dim' (Dimocarpus), 'Ed' (Ed Sullivan). Writes date-like 'Eq/Oct/Nov' tokens, and the steered output is 'Eq Eq' spam.

L26n1806.name: Lone 's' word-start fragment
L26n1806.description: Fires on a lone 's' or 'S' that starts a split word (sardines, scones, Scurvy, sycamore, sponged, sudoers), and on '/s' or '.s' inside URLs and paths. Writes 'occur/occurrence' tokens, and the steered output is 'occurrence occurrence' spam.

L26n732.name: Non-Latin script characters
L26n732.description: Goes strongly negative on non-Latin script characters inside mixed text (Thai letters like 'ว', Arabic letters, Japanese kanji and kana, IPA symbols like 'ɪ' and 'ˈ'), plus a few Latin name starts such as 'Al' and 'Hal'. Writes punctuation and foreign-word tokens, and the steered output is scrambled capitals.

L25n2927.name: Split-name middle pieces
L25n2927.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'h' (Bagh), 'Pul' (Pulwarty), 'Kel' (Kelentric), 'roph' (electrophoresis), 'Hil' (Hilfiger), 'Kh' (Khisa), 'ze' (Roozeboom). Writes 'OK/ok' tokens, and the steered output is 'OKOKOK' spam.

L26n2019.name: Rec/Rom/rep word starts
L26n2019.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, especially 'rec' (recollected, recaptured), 'Rom' (Rommel), 'rep' (repelling), 'disp' (dispensed), 'cor' (coring), '-k' (-knit). Writes 'slope/peaks' tokens, and the steered output is 'slope slope' spam.
L26n2019.name_orig: Rec, Rom and rep word starts

L26n2704.name: Capitalised name starts P/Os/Caj
L26n2704.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a capitalised name split across tokens, most often 'P' (Poles, Pope, Proudhon, Palla), 'Caj' (Cajete), 'Os' (Osmond), 'Kat' (Katki), and '-c' in 'terra-cotta'. Writes 'batch' tokens, and the steered output is 'batch batch' spam.

L26n2835.name: Dev/Lib/Vi name starts
L26n2835.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Dev' (Devanand, Devi), 'Camb' (Cambio), 'Lib' (Libertarian, Libby), 'whip' (whipbirds), 'Vi' (Viennese), 'home' (renovation). Writes 'modified' tokens, and the steered output is 'modified' spam.
L26n2835.name_orig: Dev, Lib and Vi name starts

L26n1249.name: Ver/Mos/Ho word starts
L26n1249.description: Fires on the short first piece of a split word or name, mostly 'Ver' (Verne, Verilog, Inverkeithing), 'Mos' (Moshe, Moses), 'Ho' (Healing Hooves), 'Cass' (cassia), 'Ker'. Writes 'method/procedure' tokens, and the steered output is 'procedure procedure' spam.
L26n1249.name_orig: Ver, Mos and Ho word starts

L26n3006.name: Split-word middle pieces
L26n3006.description: Fires on the 2nd or 3rd piece of a long rare word split into several tokens (omn|isc|ient, german|ica, Jan|us, per|ianth), not on the first piece. Pushes toward 'magic' and 'spell' words; pushed hard it spams 'magic'.

L25n1518.name: Name-internal subword pieces
L25n1518.description: Fires (negative) on a non-initial subword piece of a multi-token proper name, strongest on 'ob' in Chern|ob|yl and 'qu' in Tar|qu|inius, mostly in place names, people and titles. Pushes toward 'parameter' and 'parameters'; steering shows no clear effect.

L26n1212.name: Digit before thousands comma
L26n1212.description: Fires on the digit right before a thousands comma in a large number (the 0 in 10,000 or 3,000, the 2 in 12,000), weaker on other digits of numbers above a thousand. Pushes toward ',' and pushed hard it spams commas.

L26n800.name: Opening quote, dash, paren
L26n800.description: Fires (negative) on the opening punctuation that starts a quoted term or an aside: an open quote or single quote, an em dash before a clarification, or '(' before a parenthetical. Pushes toward '(' and pushed hard it spams '(s)' and '((s))'.

L26n2957.name: List commas and conjunctions
L26n2957.description: Fires (negative) on the comma or 'and' between items in a list of species, ingredients or nouns (wild turkeys[,] gators, mushrooms[,] broccoli, ferns[ and] flirting), and on the adjective right before the noun in ingredient lines (dried, minced, fresh). Pushes toward 'capacity'; steering has little visible effect.

L25n2480.name: Pre-recipient words (end users)
L25n2480.description: Fires on the word right before a recipient or target noun phrase in task text: 'for' before diners, users or Magento, 'allows' and 'enables' before users, 'to' before clients, 'by' before a request. Pushes toward 'end' (as in end users); pushed, it spams 'end'.

L26n375.name: Connector before its object
L26n375.description: Fires (negative) on the preposition or conjunction that introduces an object or list item: 'by' in ravaged by fire, 'against' in protection against, 'like' in like a cold, 'or' in seizures or, plus the comma in lists such as ulcers, cracked tooth. Pushes toward 'circular' and 'adaptive' adjectives; pushed, it spams 'circular'.

L26n1800.name: Prefix stubs: nan, con
L26n1800.description: Fires (negative) on the short first piece of a scientific or long word split into tokens: 'nan' in nanoscale and nanomedicine, 'Ag' in Ag@SiO2, 'con' in conquering and coniferous, 'an' in nanosecond, 'cur' in curtailed. Pushes toward '@' and 'norm'-style tokens; steering has no clear effect.

L26n1990.name: Word-stub starts (c, cur)
L26n1990.description: Fires (negative) on a one- or two-letter stub that begins an ordinary word split into tokens, e.g. 'c' in ceded, 'cur' in curtailed, 'ch' in chops, 'sn' in snags, and capital stubs like 'Ch' in Chalmette. Pushes toward 'cut' and 'cutting'; pushed, it spams 'cut'.

L26n1902.name: Name-start stubs (Mos, Rom)
L26n1902.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or rare word split into tokens: 'Mos' in Moses and Mosque, 'Rom' in Rommel, 'mol' in molars and molting, 'ul' in ulcers, 'Si' in Si Thammarat. Pushes toward 'keep'; pushed, it spams 'keep'.

L26n1420.name: Mixed subword fragments
L26n1420.description: Diffuse: fires on odd word-internal pieces and lone letters in split words (Ophi|og|lossaceae, Wollong|ong, neur|al, the g in sweet|gums), and on 'for' before a data or software object ('Core Data for data persistence'). Pushes toward 'data'; pushed, it spams 'data'.

L25n91.name: URL starts, closing terms
L25n91.description: Diffuse: fires (negative) on 'http' or 'https' starting a URL (://), and on the word just before a closing bracket or quote, e.g. '<package-name>', 'learning rate', 'may be present'. Pushes toward quote and closing characters; steering gives no clear effect.

L25n1981.name: Stem before -ed suffix
L25n1981.description: Fires on the stem piece of a verb split from its past-tense ending, just before '-ed', '-ied' or '-ified' (well-m|aint|ained, reb|uk|ed, priv|atis|ed, Otherwise Spec|ified). Pushes toward 'd' and 'ed' endings; pushed, it spams 'dd' and 'red'.

L26n3000.name: Name-start pieces (New, Z)
L26n3000.description: Fires (negative) on the first token of a capitalised name split into pieces, before the completing piece: 'New' in New Year's and New Jersey, 'Maz' in Mazaheri, 'Z' in Zephaniah and Zheng, 'Re' in Reformation, 'Tong' in Tonga. Pushes toward 'xml'; steering shows no clear effect.

L25n2793.name: Slot before a verb
L25n2793.description: Fires (negative) on the word right before a verb: modals and auxiliaries ('would' in Fortune would lead, 'will' in will get), infinitive 'to' (to pack, to carry), and 'was' or 'were' before a passive verb. Pushes toward take, carry and bring; pushed, it spams 'take' and 'carrying'.

L25n2931.name: Modifier before 'history'
L25n2931.description: Fires (negative) on the modifier just before a head noun, strongest on 'family' in family history and 'browsing' in browsing history, plus 'medical' before provider and 'a' before stroke or disability. Pushes toward 'history' and 'historical'; pushed, it spams 'historian'.

L26n2038.name: Leading stubs (Al, Sh)
L26n2038.description: Fires (negative) on a short leading piece of a word split into tokens, most 'Al' in Alka-Seltzer, 'al' in albacore, 'Sh' in Shippuden, 'sh' in anti-seborrhenic shampoo, and 'b' in basking shark. Pushes toward plural nouns such as words, genes and items; pushed, it spams 'words'.

L26n293.name: Math and code symbols
L26n293.description: Fires (negative) on symbols inside formulas, code and abbreviations: hex digits in 0x82, the ∂ in ∂A, the o in ApoE, the comma between function arguments (t, y), and the dot in F.D.R. or M.D. Pushes toward uppercase code-like tokens such as AA, MA and IME; steering gives no clear effect.

L26n2979.name: HTML tag brackets (canvas)
L26n2979.description: Fires (negative) on the angle brackets and tag name of HTML tags, strongest on the > that ends <canvas> and on the word canvas itself; weaker on random word stubs such as hem, Kr and Ne. Pushes toward 'tag' and 'Element'; pushed, it spams 'tag tag'.

L25n1422.name: Capitalised name stubs
L25n1422.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised proper name split into tokens, right before its completion: 'Col' in Colenso, 'Car' in Carthage and Carcassonne, 'Van' in Van Gogh, 'Saint' before Francis, 'Hol' in Holman. Pushes toward 'origin'; pushed, it spams 'origin'.

L26n710.name: Capitalized word-start fragment
L26n710.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a rare or capitalized word split into several tokens, e.g. 'Ber' in Berber, 'bir' in birchen, 'hel' in helminths, 'lic' in licorice, 'Al' in Al-Ash'ari; pushes toward '(-' and '[-' tokens.

L25n630.name: Numbered-reference label word
L25n630.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before a number that names a section: 'Chapter', 'Section', 'Figure', 'Table', 'Step', 'Article', and 'April' or 'Jan' before a day; pushes toward 'mask' tokens.

L26n2422.name: Rare-word first piece
L26n2422.description: Fires positive on the first token piece of a rare or capitalized word split into several tokens, e.g. 'TE' in TEENAGER, 'att' in attaining, 'Ar' in Arnett, 'Al' in aldehyde, '-te' in -teens; pushes toward 'license' and 'cert' tokens.

L26n1353.name: Short mid-word fragment
L26n1353.description: Goes strongly negative on a short 1-3 letter piece inside or opening a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'if' in Porifera, 'ver' in Averroes, 'rit' in fritters, 'f' in frogs, 'inf' in infested; pushes toward 'Fl' tokens.

L26n2232.name: Long-name opening piece
L26n2232.description: Fires positive on the first or middle piece of a long rare word or proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Mag' in Magritte, 'str' in straddles, 'qu' in reconquering, 'Cl' in Clifton; pushes toward 'fraction' and 'ratio' tokens.

L26n1211.name: Early split-word piece
L26n1211.description: Goes strongly negative on an early piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'che' in CHEESE, 'ev' in evaporation, 'mish' in mishaps, 'Sl' in Slides, 'ES' in HESITATE; pushes toward '(ap' and 'AP' tokens.

L25n651.name: Name and word-start pieces
L25n651.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a name or word split across tokens, e.g. 'Ch' in Chaco, 'Min' in Minas, 'dr' in drab, 'Kol' in Kolowich, 'cl' in clés; pushes toward '[]' and '{}' tokens.

L26n2987.name: Short word-start fragment
L26n2987.description: Fires positive on a short first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'le' in lethal, 'Lo' in loosely, 'fo' in Styrofoam, 'H' in HAVING, 'F' in focusing; pushes toward 'cond' and 'Conditional' tokens.

L26n1595.name: Word-internal stem fragment
L26n1595.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece inside a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'rib' in arribadas, 'ob' in retinoblastoma, 'ann' in Tyrannosaurus, 'hem' in hemlock, 'hil' in hillocks; pushes toward 'lock' tokens.

L26n2423.name: Long-word opening piece
L26n2423.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a long technical word split into tokens, most strongly 'metast' in metastasis and 'synth' in synthase, and weaker on 'paraph' in 'Can you paraphrase'; pushes toward 'asset' tokens.

L26n2569.name: Name-start fragment, weak
L26n2569.description: Goes weakly negative (about 4-6 of 10) on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mat' in Matoniaceae, 'Tam' in tampons, 'sm' in smokes, 'Ray' in Ray Hubbard; pushes toward 'survey' and 'Sur' tokens.

L25n687.name: Opening piece, 'str'
L25n687.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, most strongly 'str' in Straits and 'ph' in phylum, also 'acc' in Maccabean and 'idd' in Megiddo; pushes toward 'xy' and 'abc' letter-run tokens.

L26n1742.name: Wol/Ber name openers
L26n1742.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'Wol' in Wolpertinger and wolfsbane, 'Ber' in Berzelius, 'sal' in salinity, 'bur' in burrows, 'Hal' and 'Cal' in proper names; pushes toward 'channel' tokens.

L26n2576.name: Verb-prefix fragment
L26n2576.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split word that looks like a verb prefix, e.g. 'compl' in complies, 'imp' in implicate, 'ab' in abridged, 'app' in appalled, 'priv' in privy; pushes toward 'reset' tokens.

L26n1875.name: Capital T name starts
L26n1875.description: Goes strongly negative on a capital first letter that starts a proper noun or word split into tokens, most often 'T' in Tomo, Treatise, Toulouse and Tove, and 'Bo' in Bois Blanc; pushes toward 'version' tokens.

L26n2129.name: Recipe and serving text
L26n2129.description: Fires positive in recipe and cooking steps on the first piece of an ingredient or dish word ('s' in scones, 'S' in Serves, 'self' in self-raising) and on step punctuation; pushes toward 'server' and 'serve' tokens.

L26n2934.name: Capital P/Pr openers
L26n2934.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a name or word split into tokens, often a capital 'P', 'Pr' or 'ch', e.g. 'Pr' in PrEP, 'P' in Polding and Pomeranian, 'ch' in chameleons; pushes toward 'confirm' and 'validation' tokens.

L26n694.name: Maths and geometry context
L26n694.description: Fires positive on function words ('and', 'of', 'the', 'to') inside maths and geometry explanations, e.g. 'and' in 'base and height', 'of' in 'quotient of cosine', 'the' before 'area'; pushes toward 'geometry' tokens.

L26n2893.name: Short fragment, 'ret'/'at'
L26n2893.description: Fires positive on a short piece inside or opening a split word or name, e.g. 'ret' in Isotretinoin, 'at' in Crataegus, 'mer' in methylmercury, 'tet' in tetraplegia, 'Had' in Hadley; pushes toward 'farm' tokens.

L26n2950.name: Name-opening fragment, 'cre'
L26n2950.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'cre' in Lucrece, 'Ann' in Annunciation, 'Ah' in Aaron, 'oul' in Boulton, 'euth' in Euthanasia; pushes toward 'API' tokens.

L25n486.name: Name-suffix and abbreviation pieces
L25n486.description: Fires on pieces of capitalized names and abbreviations: 'Jr' after a surname, 'Av' in Confederate Av, 'rg' in Brgoch, 'Cr' in a URL parameter, and 'Ltd' or 'Inc' after company names. Pushes toward short consonant-cluster fragments like 'mt' and 'tn'.

L25n2615.name: Chemical compound name pieces
L25n2615.description: Fires on a middle piece of a chemical or biochemical name that still has pieces to come: 'mer' in methylmercury, 'rid' in pyridoxine, 'hydro' in dihydrotestosterone, 'rist' in myristic, 'mit' in palmitic. Pushes toward 'chemical' and 'chemistry'.

L26n2170.name: Split word-root fragments
L26n2170.description: Fires on an unfinished word-root piece with more pieces still to come: 'neut' in neutrons, 'elect' in electrons, 'nit' in nitrate, 'cent' in centred, 'Aud' in Audacity. Pushes toward short 'r' and 'ra' fragments.

L26n612.name: Word pieces, comment tokens
L26n612.description: Fires on an unfinished word piece with more to come: 'oc' in tocopherol, 'trib' in tribes and tribosphenic, 'Ven' in venom, 'ecc' in ecclesiastical, 'ul' in ulcers, 'FA' in FADE IN. Pushes toward C-style comment tokens such as '//', '*/' and '/**'.

L25n1470.name: Word-start fragments (sup, pl)
L25n1470.description: Fires on an unfinished word-start fragment with more pieces to come: 'multip' in multiplication, 'Sup' in Supposedly, 'Tem' in Temperament, 'Im' in Imp, 'p' in stockpiling. Pushes toward 'pl' fragments.

L26n2076.name: List and instruction connectives
L26n2076.description: Fires on a connective that sets up the next item in a list or instruction: 'with' after brush, cover or seal verbs, 'into', 'or' between options, 'any' after double-click, 'eg' and commas in example lists. Also fires on some word starts like 'P' in Pomeranian and 'm' in mites. Pushes toward 'goods' and 'commodities'.

L26n2189.name: Compound-term first halves
L26n2189.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or two-word term: 'pay' in payback period, 'phil' in philadelphus, 'Nickel' in Nickelodeon, 'solic' in solicitor, 'Golden' in Golden Retriever. Pushes toward 'back' and 'returned'.

L25n2334.name: Negative contraction stems
L25n2334.description: Fires on the stem before the apostrophe in negative contractions: 'isn' in isn't, 'couldn' in couldn't, 'weren', 'doesn', 'didn', 'don'. The 't' after the stem stays near zero. Pushes toward apostrophe-less forms like 'isnt' and 'didnt'.

L26n2349.name: F-initial word fragments
L26n2349.description: Fires on a short f-initial piece that starts an unfinished word or name: 'Fe' in Feinberg, 'fe' in fevers and febrile, 'Fl' in Flavius, 'fl' in fluoroquinolones, 'Fr' in Franks. Pushes toward 'surface' tokens.

L26n591.name: Mid-title heading words
L26n591.description: Fires on a word inside a multi-word heading, title or list label: 'Mental' in Psychiatric and Mental Health, 'Target' in Define Your Target Audience, 'of' in Basics of Web Development. Pushes toward capitalized 'P', 'Post' and 'Path' tokens.

L26n2902.name: Consonant-onset word fragments
L26n2902.description: Fires on a short unfinished fragment that starts a longer word, typically st, ste, tre, cre, bre or ag: 'tre' in treacherous, 'ste' in steaming, 'st' in stirs, 'Cre' in Cremonesi. Pushes toward 'composition' and 'compose'.

L26n3012.name: Capitalized name fragments
L26n3012.description: Fires on an unfinished capitalized name piece: 'Ju' in Juárez, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Rad' in Radó, 'Bar' in Bar Giora, 'Ber' in Beriberi, and 'ass' in assessor. Pushes toward 'ensure' and 'ensuring'.

L25n923.name: Split-word pieces (sneezing)
L25n923.description: Fires on an unfinished word piece with more to come in health and nature text: 'sne' in sneezing, 'seaw' in seaweed, 'z' in zoonotic, 'ig' in Zuigetsu, 'o' in oaks, 'aw' in Seawater. Pushes toward 'dry' and 'wet'.

L26n2119.name: Modifier before value nouns
L26n2119.description: Fires on the word right before a value-type noun: 'time' in time value of money, 'nutritional' in nutritional value, 'conservation' in conservation benefits, 'academic' in academic potential. Pushes toward 'value' and 'worth'.

L26n1465.name: Capital U of U.S.
L26n1465.description: Fires on the capital 'U' that opens 'U.S.' after 'the' (the U.S. Department, the U.S. Geological Survey), and on 'U' in UCLA and Uffizi. Pushes toward 'fun' and 'func' tokens.

L26n2203.name: Opening fragments of names
L26n2203.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a multi-token proper name: 'K' in Kourou, 'Sus' in Susilo, 'Dis' in Disraeli, 'Jud' in Judah, 'Mon' in Monet, 'Fu' in Fumus. Pushes toward 'result' and 'conclusion'.

L25n1052.name: Proper-noun middle pieces
L25n1052.description: Fires on a middle piece of a capitalized name split into several tokens: 'ule' in Suleiman, 'ut' in Sutak, 'Serg' in Sergipe, 'Riv' in Riviera, 'Hil' in Hilfiger. Pushes toward 'stage' and 'phase'.

L26n1035.name: Onset fragments f/fl/bl
L26n1035.description: Fires on a short f or b onset (fl, f, bl, br) that starts the unfinished second piece of a word: 'fl' in flowering and flanged, 'f' in fables, 'bl' in bladder, 'br' in brave. Pushes toward 'benefit' and 'advantage'.

L26n2102.name: Later name pieces
L26n2102.description: Fires on an unfinished later piece of a split name or word: 'amb' in Rambouillet and Bambang, 'Mand' in Mandeb, 'row' in Woodrow, 'spe' in asparagus spears, 'tre' in treble, 'inated' in polychlorinated. Pushes toward 'dec' tokens.

L25n1855.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L25n1855.description: Fires on an unfinished word or name piece, usually capitalized: 'hyper' in hyperacusis, 'Ch' in Chhattisgarh and Chakma, 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'Kh' in Khadur, 'Tr' in Trang. Pushes toward comma-quote tuple tokens.

L25n1779.name: Foundational principle modifiers
L25n1779.description: The adjective 'basic', 'fundamental' or 'core' (or 'principle(s)') right before a noun for a set of rules or assertions: 'basic assertion', 'five principles', 'basic guidelines', 'First and Second Laws'; pushes toward 'post' prefixes.

L26n2836.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L26n2836.description: A middle piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly in names or rare words (Al|fon|so, cre|vas|se, Hend|rick|son, F|os|cam); pushes toward word-starting 's' pieces (sl, sc, sm).

L26n66.name: Adjective stem awaiting suffix
L26n66.description: The stem of an adjective or noun cut off before its ending, e.g. 'mathematic' (mathematics), 'visual' (visually), 'Scientific' (-ally), 'MySQL' before 'database'; pushes toward single-letter word endings (y, c, m, x).

L26n119.name: Split-word piece before ending
L26n119.description: A short piece inside a word split into tokens, right before its ending (sc|orp|ions, catast|roph|es, Val|g|us, tab|ula| rasa, sanct|u|aries); pushes toward capital-letter tokens (N, V, G, NFT).

L26n2424.name: Surname first-piece
L26n2424.description: The first or middle piece of a surname split into tokens (Ram|ihant, Nim|etz, Alf|ano, Mac|allum, Hans|berry, Pis|ano); pushes toward closing backticks (.`).

L26n535.name: Medical word stem split
L26n535.description: A word stem where the word runs on into a suffix or second part (dys|lex|ia, bermud|agr|ass, Dec|id|uous, Sex|ism, placent|itis); pushes toward 'other/another' repeats.

L26n213.name: Compound prefix non/semi
L26n213.description: The prefix 'non', 'semi', 'anti' or 'neuro' that opens a hyphenated compound modifier (non|invasive, non|heated, semi|annually, non|stick); pushes toward 'an/An' tokens with little effect.

L25n1831.name: 'to' before action verb
L25n1831.description: 'to' (also 'by', 'just', 'simply') right before a bare action verb in how-to instructions: 'prompts the user to input', 'allow users to enter', 'can just type'; pushes toward 'type/types' tokens.

L26n2666.name: Leading capital-letter piece
L26n2666.description: The short first piece of a capitalized name or noun split into tokens, often a lone 'P' or 'Sh' (P|uma, P|olar bear, Sh|iloh, Carr|adine); pushes toward 'DNA' and 'password' tokens.

L25n537.name: Number before its unit
L25n537.description: A digit or '(' right before a unit or scale word: the digit in '$9.5 million' or '£30,000', the '(' in 'Mass (m)', 'mil' in million; pushes toward 'm/mm/mg' unit tokens.

L26n1613.name: Technical-term mid-word piece
L26n1613.description: A short middle piece of a long technical word (β-ad|renom|imetic, dem|ineralize, m|ucus, clind|am|ycin); pushes toward 'state/states' repeats.

L25n1581.name: Word-start ir/ar/str cluster
L25n1581.description: The opening 'ir', 'ar', 'str', 'gr' or 'fr' piece of a word split into tokens (ir|ritable, ir|ises, ar|mpits, str|atosphere, Ar|terial, Str|asburg); pushes toward 'move/transfer' words.

L26n1682.name: Start of proper name
L26n1682.description: The first piece of a capitalized name or place split into tokens, especially 'Al' (Al|mazaras, Al|amo, Al|amein, Al|ka-Seltzer), 'Mont', 'Con', 'Est'; pushes toward closing code tokens like ')" and ']]'.

L25n2694.name: Word before 'time'
L25n2694.description: The word just before 'time' in date/time or 'specific/certain/current time' phrases ('dates and time', 'a specific time', 'tell time'); pushes toward 'time' repeats.

L26n2390.name: Word-start st/int fragment
L26n2390.description: The opening 2-4 letters of a word split into tokens, mostly 'ste/st' (ste|amed, ste|amer, st|rolled, st|earic) and 'int/imp/app' (int|onation, imp|licate, app|alled); pushes toward 'seem/appear' tokens.

L26n956.name: Lone w/t word-start
L26n956.description: A lone 'w' or 't' (or 'unw') opening a word split into pieces (w|obbling, w|iser, W|ool, unw|rapped, t|amed); pushes toward 'bound/boundless' repeats.

L25n991.name: Word-start gr/pl
L25n991.description: The opening 'gr' or 'pl' piece of a word split into tokens (gr|ain, gr|ubs, Gr|izzly, gr|inds, snow pl|ow); pushes toward 'w/v' letter tokens.

L26n1648.name: Inside multi-word names
L26n1648.description: A token inside a multi-word name or term that continues past it (Coretta Scott King, Bill de Blasio, Evan O'Brien, Basic Local Alignment, minimum inhibitory concentration); pushes toward 'input' tokens.

L26n1464.name: Word before predicate
L26n1464.description: A function word just before a predicate: 'being' and 'be' before a verb or adjective (being bullied, be afraid), 'so' before an adjective, 'getting', 'use'; pushes toward 'lie/lies/lying' repeats.

L25n2934.name: Technology noun modifiers
L25n2934.description: A word inside a technology or equipment noun phrase just before its head noun (electronic [cigarette], Jet [Propulsion], Radio [Science], welding, laser, hookah); pushes toward 'device/devices'.

L26n435.name: Name fragments → buying
L26n435.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split proper name or odd word, e.g. 'B' in ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’ or '2B', 'Ibn', 'Ac'; pushes the model toward 'buy' and 'purchase'.

L26n1453.name: Negative name fragments→digital
L26n1453.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle piece of a split name, e.g. 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'aw' in Mawr, 'Mart' in Martel, 'Ted' in Ted Stevens; pushes toward 'digital'.

L26n1569.name: Name starts → custom
L26n1569.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized person or place name where it begins, e.g. 'Gu' in Guinean, 'Le' in Lechner, 'Ant' in António; pushes toward 'custom' and 'customized'.

L25n794.name: Software-tool names → interface
L25n794.description: Goes strongly negative on the name of a software tool or language, e.g. 'mikro' in mikroC, 'scipy', 'Matlab', 'Audacity', 'PyInstaller'; pushes toward 'interface'.

L26n1354.name: Capital H names→button
L26n1354.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a capitalized name, mostly 'H' in Hittites, Hellenistic and Hertfordshire, and 'eth' in Aethiopia; pushes toward 'button'.

L25n1597.name: Mid-word fragments → sc
L25n1597.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long technical or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'andes' in incandescent, 'ores' in electrophoresis, 'os' in colonoscopy, 'cre' in Lucrece; pushes toward 'sc' word starts.

L26n2155.name: Name onsets → cycle
L26n2155.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized proper name in news or history, e.g. 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Sar' in Saracen, 'Ps' in Psophodes, 'Luk' in Lukin; pushes toward 'cycle'.

L26n2083.name: Medical/geology adjectives → stone
L26n2083.description: Fires on an adjective modifier before its noun in medical or geology phrasing, e.g. 'arterial' (hypertension), 'coronary', 'urinary', 'cervical', 'volcanic'; pushes toward 'stone', 'rock' and 'bone'.

L26n1099.name: Word stems → equivalent
L26n1099.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'dise' in diseased, 'stere' in stereotyping, 'pharmac' in pharmacists, 'Mes' in Mesopotamia; pushes toward 'equ' and 'equivalent'.

L26n2314.name: Word-start fragments → bot
L26n2314.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening 2–3 letter piece of a split word, e.g. 'str' in straits, 'fil' in filicaleans, 'Vir' in virulent, 'Geob' in Geobacter; pushes toward 'bot' and 'robot'.

L26n32.name: Quoted phrases → quotes
L26n32.description: Fires on the key word inside a quoted or titled phrase, e.g. ‘true’ in ‘true’ play, ‘real’ in ‘real’ Washington, ‘holy’ in ‘holy grail’; pushes toward opening quote marks. Diffuse and noisy, with weak top-token evidence.

L26n2355.name: Rare-word fragments → lambda
L26n2355.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a rare or medical word split into tokens, e.g. 'xy' in hydroxylysine, 'il' in vitiligo, 'fal' in fallopian, 'yol' in yolk; pushes toward 'lambda'.

L25n1693.name: Award/prize names → pr
L25n1693.description: Fires on the honour or prize word itself, e.g. 'Knight' (of the Garter), 'Nobel' (laureate, Peace Prize), 'Royal' (Society), 'Booker' (-winning); pushes toward 'pr' fragments.

L26n2338.name: Name fragments → con
L26n2338.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a split proper name, often a place or person, e.g. 'lan' in Hojiblanca, 'Dur' in Durban, 'ac' in Chacocente, 'Ras' in Rasporich; pushes toward 'con' tokens.

L26n1342.name: Physics, names → charge
L26n1342.description: Fires on the first piece of a word in circuit, physics or name contexts, e.g. 'washing' in washing-machine circuit problems, 'rel' in relativity, 'fil' in filaments; pushes toward 'charge' and 'voltage'.

L26n1617.name: Drug/chemical names → binary
L26n1617.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long drug, chemical or technical name split into tokens, e.g. 'ly' in aminoglycoside, 'ind' in clindamycin, 'tert' in tert-butyl, 'inn' in cinnamon; pushes toward 'binary'.

L25n1297.name: S-cluster starts → span
L25n1297.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split word, often s- or st-led, e.g. 'sh' in shakshuka, 'sl' in slivered, 'ste' in steamed, 'ze' in zebras; pushes toward 'sp' and 'span'.

L26n2418.name: Capital starts → sleep
L26n2418.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized word or name mid-sentence, especially short caps such as 'Ad' (Adoration), 'C' (Cohansey), 'G' (Ghetto), 'W' (Wet Weather), and 'ret' in retelling; pushes toward 'sleep'.

L26n2284.name: Word-start fragments → section
L26n2284.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, often a consonant-led fragment such as 'Bre' (Broad-Breasted), 'arr' (arrhythmia), 'Z' (Zhen Jing), 'b' (braising), 'Lal' (Laliberté); pushes toward 'section'.

L25n2678.name: Rare-word starts → repeat
L25n2678.description: Fires on the first fragment of a rare or unfamiliar word split into tokens, e.g. 'j' in jicama, 'intr' in intravenous, 'kr' in krill, 'amb' in rambutan, 'wre' in wreaths; pushes toward 'repeat'.

L25n1333.name: Rare-word opening fragment
L25n1333.description: Fires on the short first piece (lo, qu, wal, glo) of a rare word split across tokens, before the word is finished (lo|cket, qu|asar, wal|nuts); the finishing piece stays low. Pushes toward 'offer' and 'offering'.

L26n1745.name: Identity and group terms
L26n1745.description: Strongly negative on identity and group-label words: LGBT, gay, racial, ethnic, gender, race, national identity, and phrases like 'identified as' or 'no longer identify'. Pushes toward 'identify' and 'identified'.

L26n2790.name: Split-word opening piece
L26n2790.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split across tokens when that piece is not yet a word (Sup|pressed, gre|ening, intr|avenous, Jun|o, top|ological, Per|itoneal). Pushes toward 'seat' and 'seats'.

L25n1399.name: Newline before new section
L25n1399.description: Strongly negative on word-opening fragments (thr, und, nod, gr, Bl) and on the blank line or colon that starts a new block, such as after 'Memo', a press-release header, or 'solution:'. Steering at negative dose produces newline spam.

L25n757.name: Mid-word fragment before suffix
L25n757.description: Fires on a short non-word piece inside a longer word (hyper|acusis, adul|terated, bas|al, Por|ifera, d|umb, young-ad|ult), and on 'or' in 'strong or very strong'. Pushes toward '-able' and 'ability'.

L26n1871.name: Capitalized opening fragment
L26n1871.description: Fires on the capitalized first piece of a name or word split across tokens (T|iberius, Th|orns, Th|elypteridaceae, St|alingrad, Te|es), and on 'cal' in 'calici'. Pushes toward 'necessary' and 'essential'.

L26n1489.name: Prefix fragments
L26n1489.description: Fires on the 2-4 letter opening or middle piece of a split word, not on whole words (eig|envectors, sequ|enced, flu|encer, erg|enic, equival|ently). Pushes toward 'engagement' and 'encoding'.

L25n2730.name: Short E/cad opening fragment
L25n2730.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letter piece of a split word, often a capital 'E' or 'cad' (E|ars, E|uphrates, cad|mium, enc|roachment, phen|omena). Pushes toward 'fall' and 'falls'.

L25n101.name: Period after speaker tag
L25n101.description: Strongly negative on the period that closes a speaker tag ('she noted.', 'Cameron said.') right before a quoted sentence, plus words inside quotes such as 'Imagine' and 'beginning'. Pushes toward closing quote marks.

L26n345.name: Digits inside long numbers
L26n345.description: Fires on digits inside multi-digit numbers, most on a middle or leading digit of a large figure (1,5<9>,391; 2<0>,13; 3<5>,000), and on digits in short lists like 3, 5, 7 months. Pushes toward commas, colons and full-width punctuation.

L26n2735.name: Protein name before factor
L26n2735.description: Fires on the first word or word piece of a biology term that precedes 'factor' or 'hormone' (transcription, growth, cytokine, releasing), strongest on 'transcription' and 'growth', and on 'Coll' in collagen. Pushes toward 'factor' and 'factory'.

L26n2814.name: Re- prefix opening piece
L26n2814.description: Strongly negative on the 're', 'rec', 'rem' or 'Bre' opening piece of a split word (post-Re|combination, re|connection, rem|embrance, Bre|athing, wre|cks). Pushes toward 'combination' and 'combine'.

L25n745.name: URL scheme and digits
L25n745.description: Fires on 'http' and 'https' at the start of a URL, on the first piece of split words (phot|ovoltaic, ozo|ne), and on digits in clock times such as 3:20 or 8:30. Pushes toward code closers like ]: and ):.

L26n1965.name: rec/er/m opening pieces
L26n1965.description: Fires on short opening pieces of split words, mainly 'rec' (rec|eded, rec|ollections), 'er' (er|oded, Er|win) and 'm' (newly-m|inted, m|ementos), mid-sentence; whole words stay low. Pushes toward 'walk' and 'walking'.

L26n1866.name: Extent and outcome words
L26n1866.description: Fires on extent adjectives (absolute, partial, generalized) and on the preposition or verb that sets up an outcome or state (result in, reduced to, threatened with, take over). Pushes toward 'complete' and 'total'.

L26n256.name: Naming construction (called)
L26n256.description: Strongly negative on the word that introduces a name or label (called, known as, the word, genus, named), just before the name itself (is called an abscess, the genus Diaptomus, the word khamba). Steering produces code and markdown noise.

L26n1968.name: ind/inc/und prefix pieces
L26n1968.description: Fires on opening pieces of split words beginning in 'ind', 'inc', 'und' or 'ha' (ind|uced, ind|elibly, inc|andescent, und|eniably, Ha|irstyles), not on whole words. Pushes toward 'union'.

L26n2243.name: dec and mal pieces
L26n2243.description: Fires on the short opening pieces 'dec' and 'mal' of split words (dec|arbonising, dec|oupling, Mal|oney), with weaker firing on 'dosing' and 'fertilized' suffix pieces. Pushes toward 'process' and 'procedure'.

L26n1543.name: Modifier before technical noun
L26n1543.description: Fires on the adjective or first word of a fixed technical compound, before its head noun (Large| Hadron, square| matrix, second|-order, grass| verge, Word|Net). Pushes toward 'root'.

L25n1583.name: People and place names
L25n1583.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a people, place or nation name (Kass|ites, Ber|ber, Therm|opylae, Bant|us, Two Sicilies) and on number words that open a title (Three Laws, Seven, eight track). Pushes toward 'city' and 'country'.
